name: How to Check Licensing and Insurance for LA County Paving Contractors

mainEntity.name: How can I verify that a Los Angeles County paving contractor’s insurance, license, and workers’ compensation are current and adequate for my project size?
mainEntity.text: How can I verify that a Los Angeles County paving contractor’s insurance, license, and workers’ compensation are current and adequate for my project size?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before hiring a paving contractor in Los Angeles County, it is important to confirm they are properly licensed and insured for the type of work and project scale you have in mind. Start by asking for their license number and checking it against the appropriate state contractor database to confirm status, classifications, and any disciplinary history. Make sure the license classification includes paving or concrete work, not just general construction. Next, request certificates of insurance directly from their insurance agent, not only from the contractor. These should show active general liability coverage and workers’ compensation. Review the policy limits to see whether they are reasonable for your property type, especially for larger commercial sites or multi-unit residential buildings. Ask to be added as a certificate holder so you are notified of policy changes. If the contractor uses subcontractors for any part of the job (such as grading or striping), confirm that those companies also carry valid insurance and appropriate licenses. A reputable Los Angeles County paving contractor will provide this documentation willingly and explain how their coverage protects you against accidental property damage or on-site injuries during the project.
